classification: Invalid skin directory request from hidden movie-set content; no Kodi API removal
finding: MovieSetInformationCover in DialogVideoInfo always supplied ListItem.FolderPath as dynamic directory content, including ordinary movies. Visibility predicates did not prevent the initial request. This reproduced the AVI directory error in HorizonzV; the unchanged Estuary reference did not reproduce it.
change: Supply each existing content path through a variable that is nonempty only when ListItem.IsCollection. Preserve the original ListItem.FolderPath versus Container.ListItem.FolderPath context, sort order, target and existing visibility.
source_review: GUIBaseContainer::AllocResources and SetListProvider call UpdateListProvider. DirectoryProvider evaluates the URL independently of the later group visibility; URL/limit/sort/browse changes normally schedule work only for a nonempty current URL. This is not a guarantee against every later invalidation or in-flight job.
limits: One temporary real movie set with one authored local film; native ignoreSingleMovieSets=false route used.
View401 positive list case uses enabled VideoInfo, empty set plot and native verified 16:9; full layout/all-ratio coverage is not claimed.
No plugin-backed collection, SMB collection, rapid switching or removal of final member tested.
Other previously recorded addon-info errors were not rerun and are not automatically declared resolved.
test_setup_notes: Temporary observation labels 2397/2398 existed only in isolated DialogVideoInfo/MyVideoNav copies and were removed by final production-file sync.
Filmset created and overview cleared using native JSON-RPC; backed-up original media databases and settings restored.
